editorial:
Picture two wild brothers who always ruin family parties. When their sister announces her Hawaiian wedding, the family demands they bring nice dates. So Mike and Dave post a Craigslist ad and pick Tatiana and Alice, two women who seem sweet and normal. But once they land on the island, the ladies are ready to party hard. The movie is loud, silly, and full of bad decisions, but that is exactly the point. You get a bright, sunny setting, lots of awkward moments, and a cast that clearly had fun making it.

The best part is the cast. Zac Efron and Adam DeVine play off each other well, while Anna Kendrick and Aubrey Plaza steal scenes with their wild energy. The jokes come fast, and some land better than others, but the pace keeps you moving. On the downside, the humor can feel crude and the story is pretty thin. Still, if you want a dumb, fun comedy for a Friday night, this delivers. Stream it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video, rent it on Apple TV, or grab the 4K Blu-ray for your collection.
endingExplained: In the final scenes, the wedding gets messy when secrets come out and everyone argues. Mike and Dave finally grow up a little and apologize to their sister. Tatiana and Alice also show their softer sides. The big twist is that the brothers end up with the women for real, and the wedding still happens, just with a lot more chaos. Everyone makes peace, and the movie ends on a happy, silly note.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves wild party comedies and silly buddy movies.
